form.questionContentRequired: Please add text or an image to the question.

canvas.title: Add question
canvas.testFetchError: The worksheet was created but could not be loaded; the questions were not saved. Try again.
canvas.excludeFromTraining: Exclude this page from question training
canvas.excludeFromTrainingHint: Select this if you did not mark every question on the page; option crops are still saved.
canvas.dropzoneNote: The book name is filled in automatically from the folder name.
canvas.detectorDisabledInJsonMode: Question detection is off in coordinate JSON mode; regions come from the JSON.

inspector.title: Question inspector
inspector.emptyHint: Select a question on the canvas; its choices, classification and warnings appear here.
inspector.passageInstructionPlaceholder: Tell students what to do in these items (e.g. Match the pictures).
inspector.matrixMulti: More than one correct per row
inspector.matrixCellsHint: Pick a column and draw the cell inside the row; it moves to the next column automatically. Clicking a cell marks the correct answer.
inspector.matrixCellModeTap: All cells drawn: students tap on the image.
inspector.matrixCellModeList: Students choose from the row list below the image (if every cell is drawn they tap on the image).
inspector.matrixNoRows: Draw the row boxes inside the question area first.
inspector.matrixMissingSolution: {{count}} row(s) have no correct answer; mark them before saving.
inspector.slotDrawHint: Drag inside the question area to draw a box; click a box to edit it here. A new box starts with the selected box's settings.
inspector.slotNone: Draw answer boxes inside the question area first.
inspector.slotUnitHint: Unit shown next to the box
inspector.slotTextRules: Case, extra spaces and trailing punctuation are ignored; Turkish letters are kept (İzmir = izmir, ılık ≠ ilik).
inspector.slotPaletteRules: Spaces are ignored; letters and symbols must match exactly.
inspector.slotMissing: {{count}} boxes are incomplete; finish them before saving.

slotIssue.invalidNumber: The correct value is not a readable number (e.g. 3/4, 0,75, %75, 2 3/5).
slotIssue.numberHasUnit: Don't type a unit in the correct value; add it to the units field.
slotIssue.unitsMissing: A unit is expected: list the accepted units.
slotIssue.percentWithUnit: A percentage answer cannot require a unit.
slotIssue.notSimplest: Simplest form is required but the correct value is not simplified.
slotIssue.missingAccept: Enter at least one accepted answer.
slotIssue.symbolTooLong: A symbol can be at most 8 characters.
slotIssue.missingPaletteAccept: Enter at least one accepted answer.
slotIssue.tooLong: A field is too long or has too many values.
slotIssue.entryFormMismatch: Equivalence is off: in a fraction box the correct value must also be a fraction (e.g. 3/4).
slotIssue.entryWithRequiredUnit: A fraction box has no place to type a unit: the unit can’t be required (show it next to the box).
slotIssue.invalidUnit: Each accepted unit must be something a student can type (starts with a letter, ° or a currency sign; e.g. cm, m², °C, ₺).

inspector.placeReuse: A card can be used more than once
inspector.placeDrawCard: Crop a card from the image
inspector.placeSolutionHint: Target {{n}} ({{count}}/{{capacity}}): tap its correct cards. On the canvas, click a target and then a card box.
inspector.placeSelectTargetFirst: Choose a target to assign its correct cards.
inspector.matchDrawHint: On the canvas, click a left item, then a right item to pair them.
inspector.textPaletteHint: Separate symbols with spaces (max 20, each max 8 characters). A symbol removed from the palette is also removed from the correct answers.
inspector.textLineHint: Draw a box around a line on the image, then type its text and add it. Type ( ) for gaps. Lines are ordered by the box's vertical position only: check the reading order in two-column text.
inspector.textLineReady: Line box drawn; type its text and press Add line.
inspector.textLinePlaceholder: As printed, without fixing spelling mistakes

textTokenHint.select: Click the words that are correct answers (also works on the canvas). Adjacent marked words form one target.
textTokenHint.correct: Click the misspelled words and type each target's correct form below. Adjacent words form one target ("Sonun da").
textTokenHint.punctuation: Click a gap and pick its correct mark(s).

inspector.textSplitHint: Splits the target into one target per word
inspector.textMultiTargetHint: {{count}}-word target — counts as one mistake; if they are separate mistakes, press Split.
inspector.openTextActivityOnly: Open-ended items are saved only on activity pages (they cannot be marked right / wrong in a test).
inspector.openTextHint: The student writes in the box under the image; the teacher reviews the answer (sufficient / partial / insufficient). No points.
inspector.openTextOverflowHint: Answers over {{max}} words are not saved (twice the maximum).
inspector.openTextSampleHint: The student sees it under “Show correct answers”.
inspector.openTextRubricPlaceholder: Points to look for in the answer (optional)
inspector.openTextRubricHint: Not shown to the student; shown to the teacher in the review queue.
inspector.paintDrawHint: Drag on the image to draw a region; a new region takes the brush colour. Clicking a region gives it the brush colour or clears it.
inspector.paintPolygonHint: Click the corners in order; clicking the first corner or Finish closes the polygon.
inspector.paintNumbered: Paint by number (colour of the answer)
inspector.paintNumberedHint: Each region belongs to a question number; when the student taps a region, every region with that number is painted. New regions join the selected number; clicking a region on the image moves it to the selected number.

detection.label: Source
detection.manualHint: Last version sent to training (if saved)
detection.claudeHint: Detect with Claude (~10–15 s per page; saved results are free). The next page is prepared in the background.
detection.originHint: A saved result is not charged again.
detection.aiFailed: Claude could not mark this page.
detection.unsavedEdits: You have unsaved corrections; they will be lost if the source changes.

activityDraft.contextHint: The target page is an activity: activity blocks from Claude or a manual record are applied too, and typed activities get a draft structure. Info boxes, answer keys and noise are not saved.
activityDraft.solveAsStudentHint: Opens the saved page the way a student sees it.
activityDraft.solveAsStudentNeedsSave: Pick a target page and save first.
activityDraft.toQuestionHint: Turns the activity block into a multiple-choice question.
activityDraft.untyped: This activity family has no player yet: pick an interaction type above or delete the block. Untyped activities are not saved.
activityDraft.title: Activity draft
activityDraft.claudeOnly: Draft structures are extracted only when a Claude model is configured and the page is open; you can author it by hand as well.
activityDraft.notApplied: The draft could not be applied (empty plan or it does not fit this type); draw the boxes by hand.
activityDraft.kept: Your manual edits were kept; the draft was not applied to the canvas.
activityDraft.applyConfirm: The draft will be applied to the canvas; your manual edits to this activity will be lost.
activityDraft.invalid: The draft failed validation and needs fixing:
activityDraft.solutionByHand: Fix the boxes and mark the correct answers below by hand; the draft carries no solution.
activityDraft.stale: The box changed; the draft will be extracted again.
activityDraft.reExtractHint: Ignores the saved draft and asks Claude again; this is billed.
activityDraft.reExtractConfirm: Claude will be asked again for this activity's structure and it will be billed. Your manual edits are kept; the new draft replaces them only via "Apply draft".
activityDraft.missingResult: The server returned no result for this block.
activityDraft.failed: The activity structure could not be extracted.
activityDraft.unavailable: Claude is not configured; activity structure cannot be extracted.

mask.modeHint: Draw a rectangle over the printed answer; it is covered with opaque white in the student image.
mask.title: Printed answer mask
mask.hint: Cover only the answer text or mark printed in the book ("Answer B", a tick next to an option, a coloured highlight …); do not cover the option or item itself. On save it is painted opaque white over the question image.
